label: digit 2 input early in the original phase
explanation: Fires only during the original (input) phase, never at <DEL> or during copy. The dominant trigger is the input token 2 (20.8x lift, 68% of activation mass), mostly at positions t=0..4 and on the first occurrence of 2. Strongest activations (top examples ~0.85-1.0 of max) are 2 at t=2-3 preceded by tokens like d, x, o, f, m (e.g. f x o 2); 2 at t=0 is frequent but weak (~0.09 of max). Many early 2s do not fire (precision ~0.5), so magnitude depends on the preceding prefix, not captured by a simple rule. Secondary weaker triggers: h, g, l, y, 0 inputs early in the sequence after similar prefixes (~25% of mass). Essentially silent at t>=6, on repeated tokens, and on letters a, b, r and most others.
